entities.name: Closure of the Sugar Industry
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After over 350 years of sugar production, the government closed the state-owned sugar company in 2005 due to persistent losses and the end of EU preferential pricing. The closure marked the end of an era that had defined the islands' identity, economy, and social structure since the 1640s.
